shows_x000D__x000A_`mssql_errorlog_signal_count` = count of selected ERRORLOG patterns in a **rolling ~6 hour** window (`xp_readerrorlog`, scrape every ~5m)._x000D__x000A__x000D__x000A_| Signal | Meaning | Typical action |_x000D__x000A_|---|---|---|_x000D__x000A_| `transaction_log_full_9002` | Log full (often `LOG_BACKUP` / `ACTIVE_TRANSACTION`) | Free log / take log backup / check long tx |_x000D__x000A_| `filegroup_full_1105` | Filegroup cannot allocate page | Add space / autogrowth / clean data |_x000D__x000A_| `backup_disk_full_112` | Backup device OS error 112 (disk full) | Free backup volume |_x000D__x000A_| `slow_io` | I/O taking longer than 15s | Storage / SAN / VM disk latency |_x000D__x000A_| `buffer_latch_timeout_845` | Buffer latch timeout | I/O / memory / latch contention |_x000D__x000A_| `latch_timeout` | Generic latch timeout | Correlate with waits / blocking |_x000D__x000A_| `deadlock_1205` | Deadlock victim | Trace deadlock graph / app retry |_x000D__x000A_| `4014_client_disconnect` | Client could not reuse session | Network / app pool / idle timeout |_x000D__x000A_| `network_178xx` | Network read/write errors 17828/17830 | Network path / firewall / NIC |_x000D__x000A_| `8645_memory_grant` | Memory grant timeout / wait | Memory pressure / query grants |_x000D__x000A_| `ag_suspend_from_redo` | AG data movement suspended (redo) | Fix secondary / resume AG |_x000D__x000A_| `redo_error_3313` | Redo logged-op failure | AG health / corruption check |_x000D__x000A_| `redo_worker_failure` | Redo worker failed to start | AG secondary
